evidence.citation: Artifact: "Before making a durable guidebook claim: - Re-run the same case blindly 2–3 times with fresh, context-free agents and report the pass rate. ... - Sweep for leaked changes after every run. - Re-evaluate every other golden case after any revision, including previously passing cases."

rationale: The artifact’s requested execution work is tied to establishing reliability, independent evaluation, regression status, and leak inspection before a durable guidebook claim.
